[CRITICAL] CLOSE_REQUIRED
subject: plan-0001
reason: B5_STOP_REJECTED
at: 2026-10-09T03:00:00Z
What happened: The exchange definitively rejected the stop after the fill, and the stop was not sent again (B5_STOP_REJECTED).
Position: A position is open without a stop.
System already did: The plan moved to CLOSE_REQUIRED, new entries are blocked (SAFE_MODE CLOSE_REQUIRED) and a reduce-only MARKET emergency close was attempted; if that close fails, EMERGENCY_CLOSE_FAILED or EMERGENCY_CLOSE_NOT_SENT follows as its own alert. The stop intent was journaled as rejected and a PROTECTIVE_REJECTED alert with the same reason code was raised.
You must: Check the exchange position and the journal for the rejection before any manual action. If the position is still open, close it yourself.
